defaultWhy: Fragile co-leaders at 92: Torque cockpit and Question tabs tie; Torque cockpit is listed first because it alone puts the split, the 3D and the worst moment on one screen (stacked FF + FB area up to commanded, a live 'target · FF + FB = commanded → applied' readout, FB 24 % in big type). Question tabs is the equal alternative: it opens on one calm answer ('ff v2: 43 % less shoulder error, FB share 23 % → 6 %'), shows the whole group's feedback share over time as bands, and mirrors the Rerun 'questions' layout you already picked. Sidebar + sections (89) is the cheapest to ship: today's viewer plus a run list.
decisionHinge: Does the run view open on one run or on the group? On one run, Torque cockpit; on the group, Question tabs (it wins on repeats as bands everywhere, loses on where/when because error, torque and 3D are on different tabs). If shipping cost matters more (move 10 points to B6), Sidebar + sections wins. The splice that removes the hinge: Question tabs' answer cards and tab names, Torque cockpit as the 'Where does the torque come from?' tab's right half, and the shared run sidebar (all five already have it).
